notes.title: Bridge Creator runs on AMD Graphics Hardware
notes.content:
Bridge Creator runs on AMD hardware starting with the Radeon HD 7700 series.

Please make sure that you have the latest drivers for your graphics card before running the game.

Get latest drivers here:
http://support.amd.com/us/gpudownload/Pages/index.aspx

notes.title: AMD Graphics Card Requirements
notes.content: We are working on supporting AMD graphics cards. The game runs currently only on NVIDIA graphics cards.
